description.en: OpenBMB VoxCPM 0.5B tokenizer-free TTS model supporting short-reference voice cloning and streaming output (16kHz).
description.zh: OpenBMB VoxCPM 0.5B 无分词器 TTS 模型，支持短参考音色克隆与流式输出（16kHz）。

seed.en: Random seed for MiniCPM and diffusion sampling.
seed.zh: MiniCPM 与扩散采样的随机种子。

max_tokens.en: Maximum MiniCPM output tokens; default 4096. Zero selects model max_length; negative counts are rejected.
max_tokens.zh: 最大MiniCPM输出令牌；默认4096。零选择模型max_length；负计数被拒绝。

min_tokens.en: Minimum MiniCPM output tokens before an EOS stop is honored; default 2.
min_tokens.zh: 兑现 EOS 停止之前的最低 MiniCPM 输出代币；默认 2。

num_inference_steps.en: CFM diffusion sampling steps; default 10. Must be positive.
num_inference_steps.zh: CFM扩散采样步骤；默认 10。必须为正数。

guidance_scale.en: CFM classifier-free guidance rate. Must be nonnegative.
guidance_scale.zh: CFM 无分类器指导率。必须是非负的。

prompt_text.en: Text prompt for prompt-continuation voice cloning.
prompt_text.zh: 用于提示续写式音色克隆的文本提示。

reference_text.en: Alias for prompt_text; text prompt for prompt-continuation voice cloning.
reference_text.zh: prompt_text 的别名；提示续写式音色克隆的文本提示。

text_chunk_mode.zh: 文本分块模式；默认 tag_aware。

retry_badcase.en: Retry when generation is detected as a bad case; defaults to true offline and false in streaming. Streaming ignores an explicit true value with a warning.
retry_badcase.zh: 检测到坏例时重试；离线默认 true，流式默认 false。流式会忽略显式 true 并警告。

retry_badcase_max_times.en: Maximum total generation attempts when retrying bad cases, including the initial attempt; default 3. Must be positive.
retry_badcase_max_times.zh: 重试坏例时的最大总生成尝试次数（含首次尝试）；默认 3，必须为正。

retry_badcase_ratio_threshold.en: Bad-case ratio threshold for retry decisions. Must be positive.
retry_badcase_ratio_threshold.zh: 重试决策的坏例比例阈值；必须为正。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum characters per offline text chunk; must be positive. Does not control streaming chunk cadence.
text_chunk_size.zh: 离线文本分块的最大字符数；必须为正。不控制流式分块节奏。

language.en: Language hint for Chinese-script normalization; Cantonese/yue preserves Traditional characters. Inherits structured transcript or voice language when provided.
language.zh: 中文脚本归一化的语言提示；Cantonese/yue 保留繁体字。提供结构化转写或音色语言时继承该语言。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)
